subject.summary: Approximate 1963 model-year Volkswagen Type 2 T1 Samba, the 23-window deluxe microbus with split windscreen, skylights, rear corner windows and the folding sunroof: side, plan and front traced from a blueprint scaled to the documented wheelbase and width, built as a model kit's parts are.

views.label: Curved rear corner windows and louvres

identity.feature: Split windscreen: two flat panes in a shallow V with a centre post, under the roof's peak
The V-front: the nose with its V-shaped two-tone panel lines and the large VW roundel, round headlamps set in the nose
23 windows: eight skylights along the roof edges, the side windows, the curved rear corner windows
The folding fabric sunroof in four panels
The bus silhouette: flat sides, a tumblehome window band, a round-shouldered roof, short overhangs, engine louvres and the bi-parting cargo doors
